name: Agumon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name and 1 [Marcus Damon] among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your yellow or red Tamers becomes suspended, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
